title: Fix profile page 'not found' error and resolve all routing/code issues

requirements.text: Audit and fix the Profile page route configuration in App.tsx so that navigating to a user's profile (both own profile and other users' profiles) renders the Profile component correctly without a 'not found' error. Ensure the route parameter (e.g., userId or username) is correctly defined in the TanStack Router route tree and matches what Profile.tsx expects to read from route params.

quotes: Now the profile page says not found please go through all code and solve all issues

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /profile/:userId (or the correct route path) loads the Profile page without a 'not found' error
Own profile link from the navigation bar loads the authenticated user's profile correctly
Clicking another user's profile link navigates to their profile page correctly
No console errors related to route resolution on the profile page

requirements.text: Review the Profile.tsx component and fix any issues with how it resolves the userId from route params. Ensure it correctly distinguishes between viewing one's own profile (using the authenticated principal) and viewing another user's profile, and that all backend query calls (fetch profile, fetch videos, fetch saved videos) use the correct user identifier.

quotes: please go through all code and solve all issues

acceptanceCriteria: Profile page correctly loads profile data for the given user ID
Videos tab shows videos belonging to the correct user
Saved videos tab shows only the authenticated user's saved videos when viewing own profile
Edit profile button appears only when viewing own profile
Follow button appears only when viewing another user's profile

requirements.text: Audit all navigation links and programmatic navigations throughout the app (Layout.tsx bottom nav, VideoCard.tsx, Notifications.tsx, Leaderboard.tsx, Conversation.tsx, Inbox.tsx, etc.) that link to a user profile page, and ensure they all use the correct route path and pass the correct user identifier as a route parameter.

quotes: please go through all code and solve all issues

acceptanceCriteria: All profile links throughout the app navigate to the correct profile route with a valid user identifier
No broken or malformed profile URLs exist anywhere in the UI
Bottom navigation 'Profile' item navigates to the authenticated user's own profile

requirements.text: Perform a full audit of backend/main.mo to identify and fix any issues with profile-related query and update functions: getUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile, updateProfile. Ensure they handle missing profiles gracefully and return appropriate error variants rather than trapping.

quotes: please go through all code and solve all issues

acceptanceCriteria: getUserProfile returns a proper null/option or error variant when a profile does not exist instead of trapping
saveCallerUserProfile and updateProfile correctly persist and retrieve profile data
No runtime traps occur when accessing profile-related endpoints

requirements.text: Audit the useQueries.ts hooks related to profiles (useFetchUserProfile, useSaveCallerUserProfile, useUpdateProfile) and fix any issues with how backend responses are decoded, how loading/error states are handled, and ensure the Profile page correctly handles the case where a profile is not yet created (new user) versus a genuinely missing/invalid user ID.

quotes: please go through all code and solve all issues

acceptanceCriteria: Profile query hooks correctly decode backend response types including option/null variants
Profile page shows a meaningful 'User not found' message for invalid user IDs rather than a broken state
Profile page shows a profile setup prompt for authenticated users who have not yet created a profile
No unhandled promise rejections or query errors in the browser console when visiting a profile

requirements.text: Fix any remaining issues across the entire frontend codebase found during the audit: broken imports, TypeScript type errors, missing route definitions, incorrect query key usage, or stale data not being invalidated after mutations that affect profile or video data.

quotes: please go through all code and solve all issues

acceptanceCriteria: No TypeScript compilation errors in the frontend
All route paths defined in App.tsx match the links used throughout the app
Mutations that modify profile or video data correctly invalidate related React Query caches
No broken imports or missing component references

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve all existing features including the upload flow for reels and pictures restored in Version 28
nonGoals: Adding new profile features beyond fixing existing ones
Adding new backend data types or schemas unrelated to the profile fix
